_about: Quality thresholds for animation packs (tools/lib/anim-quality.mjs reads them; `node tools/anim-pack.mjs lint` and tests/anim-quality.test.mjs apply them). CALIBRATED on the accepted corpus: every existing scene and small item passes, and each floor sits at the corpus MINIMUM (a ceiling at its maximum), so work thinner, flatter or more padded than anything already accepted fails. Each rule has min and/or max, the corpus median, the advisory levels warnMin / warnMax (the 10th / 90th percentile) and a note with the measured distribution it was set from.
_how: profiles: "scene" judges every full-screen scene (item.full, 1600 x 900) and "item" every small 64 x 64 item, EXCEPT the frozen legacy lists: "scene-legacy" (the templated UK packs) and "item-classic" (functional marks and the first regional waves), each calibrated on its own corpus. A new pack is always judged by the strict "scene" / "item".
warnMin / warnMax: the corpus 10th / 90th percentile. A drawing that passes but is thinner than that is listed as a thin spot by `lint` (advisory, never a failure): aim for the median.

A rule is a metric of tools/lib/anim-quality.mjs measure() (sharedShare / sharedShareAll are added by the registry lint: how much of a scene is identical to other scenes of its pack / of any pack): min is the least allowed, max the most. Keys starting with "_" and "note" are documentation. The structural rules (valid markup, unique ids, refs resolve, no transform on an x-* element, classes defined in css, sky gradient first, evening grade last) are always on and have no threshold.

richness: a composite. Each component is its value over the corpus median (capped at 125 %), averaged: 1.0 is the median accepted drawing. It stops one inflated count from hiding thin everything else. Its floor for scenes (0.66) is about the 3rd percentile, above the five thinnest accepted scenes, which are listed under waivers.

waivers: [{ref, rule, reason}]: an accepted item that does not meet one rule. Every waiver must still be needed (tests/anim-quality.test.mjs fails when a waived rule passes, so the list only shrinks), and the list is capped. Never add one for new work: fix the drawing.

To raise the bar after better scenes land: `node tools/anim-pack.mjs calibrate` shows threshold vs corpus; `calibrate --propose` prints thresholds computed from today's corpus. Never lower a threshold to let a drawing pass.

_corpus.item-classic: core, moments, rewards, seasons, sky, texas, world, uk-south-west small items (330)

scene.for: every full-screen scene (item.full) of any pack not in scene-legacy: the strict profile, calibrated on the hand-drawn US, Asia and Texas scenes (229)

scene-legacy.for: the UK scenes (frozen list: do not add a pack here): drawn from one template, so calibrated on their own corpus (168); they share most shapes with each other, which the strict profile forbids

item.for: every small 64 x 64 item of any pack not in item-classic: symbols, small-town marks, celebrations; calibrated on the US and Asia small items (245)

item-classic.for: the legacy small items (frozen list: do not add a pack here); calibrated on their own corpus (330)
